findings.evidence: `ls TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/SU2/` shows Basic.lean, Character.lean, ConjugacyClasses.lean, SymmetricPower.lean, TorusConjugacy.lean, Weyl.lean plus the new WeylCharacter.lean. Weyl.lean's header: '# The Weyl group of `SU(2)`' and 'the characters of `SU(2)` are `W`-invariant functions on `T`'; WeylCharacter.lean's header: '# The Weyl character formula for `SU(2)`', using 'Weyl denominator', 'Weyl numerator', 'Weyl chamber'. Sole importer of SU2.Weyl: TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/SU2/TorusConjugacy.lean:9.
findings.fix: In this PR: `git mv TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/SU2/Weyl.lean TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/SU2/Weyl/Basic.lean` and place the new file at `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/SU2/Weyl/Character.lean`. Only one in-repo import needs updating — `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/SU2/TorusConjugacy.lean:9` (`public import TauCeti.RepresentationTheory.SU2.Weyl` → `...SU2.Weyl.Basic`). No declaration renames; delete the old module paths.
findings.issue: The PR adds `SU2/WeylCharacter.lean` next to the existing `SU2/Weyl.lean`, leaving two files in one directory whose shared leading component `Weyl` names their common subject (the Weyl theory of SU(2): Weyl group, Weyl denominator, Weyl chamber, Weyl character formula). The repo already uses `Weyl` as a subject directory elsewhere (`TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Weyl/{Group,Chamber,Orbit,Vector,Dihedral}.lean`), so this is not a bare surname across unrelated subjects.

summary: The new file lands correctly in TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/SU2/ and both of its imports are used and narrow, but it leaves SU2/Weyl.lean and SU2/WeylCharacter.lean as flat siblings sharing the leading `Weyl` component instead of creating the SU2/Weyl/ directory.
